name: Etapp 7 Entré Syd-Entré Nord Skuleskogens nationalpark
description: Entré Syd Skuleskogens nationalpark to Entré Nord Skuleskogens nationalpark. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Skravelbäcken upper natural water: Natural-water point. Naturkartan says it usually has water even in dry, warm summers, unlike many other park streams.
notes: Höga Kusten labels the section Medel, while Naturkartan/API labels it Röd - krävande and park/field evidence describes demanding terrain.

Current trail pages say passing through the cleft is no longer recommended due to rockfall risk; field reports often say closed; national-park attraction pages still promote the sight without foregrounding the trail-page warning as strongly.
Several sources retain old Skuleberget-Köpmanholmen or Köpmanholmen-Örnsköldsvik staging, while current section 7 is Entré Syd-Entré Nord.
Naturkartan indicates grill/fireplace at Entré Syd, while national-park services guidance says South Entrance has benches and nearby Kälsviken has fireplaces.
Park has natural streams and lakes, but official guidance says no food/water refill and streams are untreated and may dry in dry summers.
Neither endpoint has direct fixed transit in current findings; older Nationalparksbussen/Världsarvsbussen references exist but no 2026 service was confirmed.

facilities.name: Entré Nord, Skuleskogen
facilities.description: North entrance / section endpoint with information, benches/tables, dry toilet nearby, fireplace, waste and signage toward Näske. No food or potable water refill. North entrance road/parking may be snow-closed in winter.

facilities.name: Toalettbyggnad Entré Nord
facilities.description: Accessible toilet building at Entré Nord.

facilities.name: Entré Syd, Skuleskogen
facilities.description: South entrance cluster with information, rest area, waste and nearby dry toilets. Naturkartan indicates grill/fireplace, but official park services say South Entrance has benches and nearby Kälsviken has fireplaces; do not import Entré Syd fireplace until reconciled. No food or potable water refill.

facilities.name: Torrtoaletter Entré Syd
facilities.description: Three accessible dry toilets at Entré Syd.

facilities.name: Kälsviken tent site
facilities.description: Designated tent area at Kälsviken. May 1-Sep 30 tenting only at designated sites, max three nights in one place. Fire only at prepared fireplaces with supplied or carried wood.

facilities.name: Kälsviken accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible dry toilet near Kälsviken shelters and tent area.

facilities.name: Salsviken tent site
facilities.description: Designated tent site on or very near the route at Salsviken. No fireplace/wood reported in facilities lane; do not import fire here unless verified.

facilities.name: Skravelbäcken upper natural water
facilities.description: Natural-water point. Naturkartan says it usually has water even in dry, warm summers, unlike many other park streams. Untested natural water; filter/boil. No potable refill exists in the park.

facilities.name: Slåttdalsskrevan
facilities.description: Iconic crevice/geological POI in Skuleskogen. Current trail pages say passing through the cleft is no longer recommended due to rockfall risk. Do not model as safe through-route. Some sources call it closed, while current official section wording says not recommended to pass through; preserve wording as hazard/reroute note unless legal closure source is found.

facilities.name: Tärnättvattnen cabin
facilities.description: Open year-round, non-bookable national-park cabin with 4 bunks, stove, wood shed, dry toilet nearby and fireplace/rest area. Shared first-come cabin, not bookable lodging. No tested drinking water; use natural water only with treatment.
